meta.title: Gandhari
description: Gandhari delivers a gripping narrative centered on a mother pushed to the absolute edge when her daughter is abducted. Refusing to yield, she embarks on an uncompromising and relentless mission to track down and rescue her missing child. This desperate search propels her through a harrowing ordeal where every step tests her resolve, transforming a parent's ultimate nightmare into an unyielding fight against time.

As the mother presses forward on her dangerous path, her arduous journey deeply explores resonant themes of revenge and redemption. Driven by unwavering devotion, she must navigate the intense emotional and moral weight of her actions while striving to recover her daughter. The narrative offers a stark look at the extreme lengths a mother will go to save her loved one and find retribution amidst a brutal personal tragedy.
